example_sentences_in_bangla: তার জোমাগোদা দেখে সবাই হাসতে লাগল।
এত খাওয়ার পর সে জোমাগোদা হয়ে গেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: Everyone laughed seeing his pot-bellied figure.
After eating so much, he has become extremely obese.
note: This idiom uses vivid imagery from traditional Bengali clothing and body descriptions to convey excess weight.
